command:
set -euo pipefail; test "$(id -un)" = ai-core-node; D=/home/ai-core-node/.config/systemd/user/frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service.d; F95=$D/95-omega-777-organ-floor.conf; F99=$D/99-omega-777-organ-floor.conf; FINAL=$D/95-voice-live-final.conf; test -f "$FINAL"; grep -Fq '/home/ai-core-node/.local/lib/frankenstein-voice-final/scripts/voice_final_runtime.py' "$FINAL"; PID0=$(systemctl --user show frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service -p MainPID --value); ENTER0=$(systemctl --user show frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service -p ActiveEnterTimestamp --value); BAK=.disabled-omega-convergence-20260913-0055; moved95=0; moved99=0; rollback(){ if [ "$moved95" = 1 ] && [ -f "$F95$BAK" ]; then mv "$F95$BAK" "$F95"; fi; if [ "$moved99" = 1 ] && [ -f "$F99$BAK" ]; then mv "$F99$BAK" "$F99"; fi; systemctl --user daemon-reload || true; }; trap 'rc=$?; if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then rollback; fi; exit $rc' EXIT; if [ -f "$F95" ]; then mv "$F95" "$F95$BAK"; moved95=1; fi; if [ -f "$F99" ]; then mv "$F99" "$F99$BAK"; moved99=1; fi; systemctl --user daemon-reload; EFFECTIVE=$(systemctl --user show frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service -p ExecStart --value); PID1=$(systemctl --user show frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service -p MainPID --value); ENTER1=$(systemctl --user show frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service -p ActiveEnterTimestamp --value); printf 'EFFECTIVE=%s
PID0=%s
PID1=%s
ENTER0=%s
ENTER1=%s
' "$EFFECTIVE" "$PID0" "$PID1" "$ENTER0" "$ENTER1"; printf '%s' "$EFFECTIVE" | grep -Fq '/home/ai-core-node/.local/lib/frankenstein-voice-final/scripts/voice_final_runtime.py'; test "$PID0" = "$PID1"; test "$ENTER0" = "$ENTER1"; trap - EXIT; echo 'SEAM_CONFIG_PASS_NO_RESTART'
